method: same element, band, selector, treatment and line count across independently held solar spectra; range is a holding repeatability diagnostic, not a total uncertainty
not_admitted: Molecular CN/NH/OH/CO routes: no same-pool cross-holding repeatability is available for promotion
IAG versus CRIRES+ J: declared wavelength pools do not overlap
Target-Sun repeatability: requires matched target spectra and joint covariance, not solar holding substitution
decision: These atomic holding ranges are retained as measured repeatability components. They do not close profile, continuum, blend, model, or target-Sun covariance terms.
